name: Functional Gaussian Splatting Representation
definition: Represents discrete 3DGS as three continuous functions: Gaussian Probability Function (GauPF) for geometry, Gaussian Color Function (GauCF) for color, and Gaussian Transform Function (GauTF) for rotation, scale, and opacity.
summary: Functional Gaussian Splatting maps discrete 3D Gaussians to continuous functions, enabling generative modeling unlike methods that modify primitive shapes.
